body: Create a whimsical still life inside a cozy alchemist shop. In the foreground, a transparent round potion flask contains a very fluffy {{animal}} that comfortably fills its entire volume like a liquid, with an exaggerated unimpressed expression. Keep the animal charming and unharmed. Paint the animal with crisp cartoon shapes while rendering the glass and wooden shelf photographically. Add three softly glowing colored bottles behind it, warm candlelight, readable silhouette, square composition.

instructions.en: No reference image is needed. Copy the full prompt into your image generator.
instructions.zh-Hans: 无需参考图，将完整提示词复制到图像生成工具即可。
